digest.component_or_area: CI linting gates and Makefile static analysis
propositions: scripts/ directory (41 files) is excluded from lint and typecheck gates; Makefile sources variable does not include it, leaving 78 ruff violations ungated including 7 files invoked by the blocking CI workflow
The 28 substantive violations (RUF100 x12, E501 x11, RUF005 x2, RUF059 x2, B905 x1, RUF036 x1) are zero-behavior fixes: dead noqa directives, line wraps, and one strict zip parameter

50 T201 (print) violations across 10 files require exemption via consolidated per-file-ignores entry; nine discretionary single-file entries must be replaced by one invariant scripts/** entry in the same change as deleting 28 redundant inline noqa directives to avoid new RUF100 violations
7 scripts files fail ruff format --check and must be reformatted before scripts/ joins Makefile sources, or make lint goes red immediately upon scope addition

Five RUF100 directives reference disabled rules (PLC0415, S603, S310, PLR0915) and must be confirmed to document no live intent before deletion; remaining 24 irreducible exceptions (E402 imports, BLE001, type: ignore) are structural and acceptable
